## Public-safety checklist

- [ ] No absolute home paths, local usernames, email addresses, or account identifiers
- [ ] No raw inventories, private filenames, personal content, or content hashes
- [ ] No credentials, sessions, databases, screenshots, archives, or media
- [ ] No machine-specific quarantine or deletion commands
- [ ] Private evidence remains outside Git
- [ ] `./scripts/validate_public_repo.sh` passes
- [ ] The staged diff was reviewed manually
